folding.layout_preserved: native circuit wires and layout retained by qem
folding.method: qem native Qiskit random local unitary folding
folding.native_inverse_policy: Gate.inverse; SX^3 if target lacks SXdg; otherwise reject unsupported inverses
folding.physical_gate_selection: seeded equal-weight physical-gate selection; virtual gates excluded
folding.scale_policy: requested scales used for fitting; recorded gate-count scales are quantized noise proxies, not calibrated noise

exchange_decomposition.note: RZ operations are virtual frame changes; RX and RZZ require physical pulses. Virtual RZ layers remain semantically required.
